skill_name: Compare and contrast printed newspapers and online news outlets.
workflow: Printed newspapers and online news outlets have many similarities and differences. On the one hand, both varieties provide the same type of content — news — to the same types of audiences. However, there are key distinctions between these two media formats. Printed newspapers are typically delivered daily and offer a more in-depth analysis from reporters, whereas online news outlets are updated in near real-time and are often more opinion-focused.
